claims.sentence: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title><jats:p> Objective To examine the association of evening eating clock time, its elapsed time to the midpoint of sleep (TEM), consumption of caffeine and sugary foods, and dinner meal size with sleep quality indicators and insomnia.</jats:p><jats:p> Methods The present study's participants (n = 2,050; 18-65 y) were part of a population-based research, with virtual data collection.
